_what: The scope a reviewer was asked to review. Growth beyond the documented tolerance means the review's subject changed under it, which is why round counting stops working. New work goes to a new branch.
_append_only: rounds[0] is the baseline, ALWAYS. Re-freezing appends; it never resets. Removing or rewriting an earlier round fails the gate, so a reset is a visible deletion in the diff, never a silent overwrite.
